title: Hearty British Red Bean Paste Bake
description: A floral and pillowy British dessert featuring anko red bean paste, baked to perfection in a Korean brass bowl, and is gluten-free friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the almond flour, sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the melted butter, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Add the red bean paste to the wet ingredients and mix until well combined.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Fold in the dried rose petals.
Pour the batter into a Korean brass bowl and smooth the top.
Bake for 40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
